known_facts_book1: Ruler of the Underground World, commanding thousands of Nomes who labour at furnaces and forges making gold, silver and jewels.
A little fat man clothed in rock-brown garments, with rock-colored hair, beard and face; Dorothy says he looks like Santa Claus of a different color.
His only ornament is a broad jewel-studded magic belt that works all his transformations and gives him his power.
Bought the Queen of Ev and her ten children as slaves from King Evoldo in exchange for a long life, then transformed them into ornaments and bric-a-brac to decorate his rooms.
Refuses Ozma's demand to free the royal family, arguing the King of Ev had a right to sell them.
Shows Ozma his vast army of mail-clad Nome warriors to prove no ruler dares fight him.
Offers each visitor a guessing game: touch objects saying 'Ev' to free the transformed royals, but be transformed yourself if all guesses fail.
Entraps Ozma, the Tin Woodman, the Scarecrow, Tiktok, all twenty-six officers and the private, turning them into ornaments — the Oz people made green, the Ev royals purple.
His secret (the royal family are purple ornaments) is overheard by Billina while she hides under his throne.
Is terrified of eggs, which are poison to Nomes; leaps in fright when Billina lays an egg under his throne.
Is blinded by two of Billina's eggs hurled by the Scarecrow, letting Dorothy unbuckle and steal his magic belt.
Without his belt his magic fails; he cannot transform his foes into scorpions and cries 'It's gone, and I am ruined!'
Fails a last attempt to trap the party; Dorothy uses his own belt to turn his pursuing warriors into eggs.
Is left scowling on his rock throne, defeated, as the rescuers depart.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: His adversary — she demands the prisoners' release; he entraps her into becoming an emerald grasshopper.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: His adversary — she defies him, steals his magic belt, and turns his warriors into eggs to escape.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The yellow hen who overhears his secret and whose eggs terrify and blind him, undoing his power.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Blinds him by hurling Billina's eggs into both his eyes during the fight.
known_relations_book1.Chief Steward: His impudent Nome steward, who scolds him and lets slip the ornaments' colors within Billina's hearing.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: His slave, whom he bought from King Evoldo and transformed into a purple ornament.
known_relations_book1.Evoldo: The King of Ev who sold his own wife and children to him for a long life.
